none: PAS NLM-131E24: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, of uncertain issuer probably 260-270, Reece period 13. Obverse description: radiate bust right. Reverse description: Possibly altar, with four pellets in its subdivided quarters. Reverse inscription: [?A]EA. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin, suggesting it might be a Consecratio issue. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: 6
